verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an aftermarket for taken names: its API supports placing backorder requests, discovering auction listings, and placing bids, and llms.txt lists aftermarket services. Watchlist monitoring of expiry and status changes supports the backorder path. Nothing in the pack shows premium pricing surfaced in search results. Missing for 10: premium pricing shown in search, a documented buy-now marketplace or broker service for taken names, independent or hands-on corroboration.
